title: Local affine flat counit presentation data
statement: Under the affine presentation hypothesis, for qcqs p:Y→B, relatively flat quasi-coherent M, g:A→B and a∈A, there exist affine opens S containing g(a), V containing a, and V≤g⁻¹(S), with a StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation for p|S, M restricted to p⁻¹(S), and g.resLE S V. The bounded flat complex K lives on S and includes both identifications and the base-change equation. No global presentation on B is asserted.

proof.text: Choose S containing g(a) from the affine-open basis of B. Choose V containing a from the affine-open basis of A inside g inverse-image S. These witnesses give the membership, affine and containment clauses. Quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of p restricted to S, and quasi-coherence of the restricted module, are supplied by the open-restriction instances.

Prove relative flatness on the restricted base by evaluating hM on the images of affine subopens under the two open inclusions. morphismRestrict_appLE and the open inclusion appIso formula identify the section modules and scalar actions literally. The same image calculation proves flatness under a source-only restriction, and applies in particular to the top-open inclusion.

Apply h_affine to p restricted to S and g.resLE S V. Evaluate its StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen predicate on the top restriction of the restricted module and the flatness just proved. Unpack K, its bound and termwise flatness, the two identifications, and the presentation equation.

Apply the top-restriction comparison to this restricted source. Keep the same K, bound and flatness witnesses; compose the base direct-image identification with e and the ordinary-pullback identification with t. Functoriality of derived pullback and associativity combine the two equations into precisely the required presentation equation.

theorem standardSingleFlatCounit_localization_presentation_data
    (h_affine : ∀ {Y₀ B₀ A₀ : Scheme.{u}} (p₀ : Y₀ ⟶ B₀)
      [QuasiCompact p₀] [QuasiSeparated p₀] [IsAffine B₀] [IsAffine A₀]
      (g₀ : A₀ ⟶ B₀), StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p₀ g₀ ⊤)
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (hM : M.IsFlatOver p) (g : A ⟶ B) (a : A) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    ∃ (S : B.Opens) (V : A.Opens), g a ∈ S ∧ a ∈ V ∧
      IsAffine S.toScheme ∧ IsAffine V.toScheme ∧
      ∃ hVS : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ S,
        StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation (p ∣_ S)
          (M.restrict (p ⁻¹ᵁ S).ι) (g.resLE S V hVS)
